title: The Garden of Small Gods
subtitle: A Novel
author: Walusimbi Leon
description: In a city apartment block, the plants begun by the dead keep growing and speaking — and a grieving widow learns to listen.
style: Tender magical realism, third-person. The ordinary made luminous; grief handled with light hands.
characters: Amara — widow, 50s, closed-off then opening; the garden — a chorus of small green voices.
setting: A weathered apartment block in a warm city, present day.
notes: Begin with a plant that should be dead blooming overnight. Amara finds her late husband's voice in the leaves. Quiet wonder.
